description: Extend PredictionVersionManager to store SmartMarketSelector's BestTip as frozen pick. Add 9 frozen pick fields (selected_market, selection_text, selection_probability, selection_confidence, selection_odds, selection_fair_odds, selection_edge, value_classification, risk_level) and 3 result tracking foundation fields (actual_result, profit_loss, settled_at). Update create_version() to accept mensione_pick parameter and populate fields from BestTip. Add foundation methods settle_prediction() and get_settled_picks_by_market() as stubs. This enables future per-market historical accuracy tracking.
steps: Read backend/app/prediction/prediction_version.py to understand PredictionVersion dataclass and PredictionVersionManager structure

Extend PredictionVersion dataclass with frozen pick fields: selected_market: Optional[str] = None, selection_text: Optional[str] = None, selection_probability: Optional[float] = None, selection_confidence: Optional[float] = None, selection_odds: Optional[float] = None, selection_fair_odds: Optional[float] = None, selection_edge: Optional[float] = None, value_classification: Optional[str] = None, risk_level: Optional[str] = None
Add result tracking foundation fields: actual_result: Optional[str] = None, profit_loss: Optional[float] = None, settled_at: Optional[datetime] = None
Add parameter: mensione_pick: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None

In create_version(), after creating version object, check if mensione_pick is BestTip: if mensione_pick and mensione_pick.get('type') == 'best_tip': version.selected_market = mensione_pick.get('market'); version.selection_text = mensione_pick.get('selection'); version.selection_probability = mensione_pick.get('probability'); version.selection_confidence = mensione_pick.get('confidence'); version.selection_odds = mensione_pick.get('bookmaker_odds'); version.selection_fair_odds = mensione_pick.get('fair_odds'); version.selection_edge = mensione_pick.get('edge'); version.value_classification = mensione_pick.get('value_classification'); version.risk_level = mensione_pick.get('risk_level')
If mensione_pick is PassDecision (type='pass_decision') or None, leave frozen pick fields as None

Add foundation method to PredictionVersionManager: def settle_prediction(self, version_id: str, actual_result: str, profit_loss: Optional[float] = None) -> Optional[PredictionVersion]: # TODO: Implement settlement logic for future historical accuracy tracking; pass

Add foundation method: def get_settled_picks_by_market(self, market_type: str, start_date: Optional[datetime] = None, end_date: Optional[datetime] = None) -> List[PredictionVersion]: # TODO: Implement query for settled picks by market type; return []
Read backend/app/prediction/service.py generate_full_prediction() to find create_version() call (around line 955)

Update call to pass mensione_pick: version = self.version_manager.create_version(match_id=match.id, stage=stage, prediction_data=prediction_data, model_versions=models_used, data_quality_score=..., confidence_score=..., notes=[...], mensione_pick=mensione_pick)
Create or extend backend/tests/test_prediction_version.py with test fixtures for BestTip dict and PassDecision dict

Test cases: (1) create_version with BestTip populates all 9 frozen pick fields, (2) create_version with PassDecision leaves frozen pick fields None, (3) create_version without mensione_pick leaves frozen pick fields None, (4) frozen pick fields preserve values correctly (no mutation), (5) actual_result/profit_loss/settled_at remain None initially, (6) settle_prediction method exists and accepts correct parameters, (7) get_settled_picks_by_market method exists and returns list
Run version manager tests: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_prediction_version.py -v
Run integration test: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_prediction_service.py::TestDevelopmentDataFallback -v to verify frozen pick stored in pipeline
acceptance_criteria: PredictionVersion has 9 frozen pick fields (selected_market, selection_text, selection_probability, selection_confidence, selection_odds, selection_fair_odds, selection_edge, value_classification, risk_level)
PredictionVersion has 3 result tracking fields (actual_result, profit_loss, settled_at) initialized to None
create_version() accepts mensione_pick: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] parameter
create_version() populates frozen pick fields when mensione_pick type='best_tip'
create_version() leaves frozen pick fields None when mensione_pick type='pass_decision' or None
settle_prediction() method exists (stub with TODO comment)
get_settled_picks_by_market() method exists (stub returning empty list)
7+ unit tests verify frozen pick storage, all passing
Integration test verifies frozen picks stored correctly in full pipeline
verification: Verify frozen pick fields populated in version object
